entities.summary: Thomas Allen Pollock was a Canadian ice hockey player. He was a member of the Edmonton Mercurys that won a gold medal at the 1952 Winter Olympics. Pollock died of a stroke in 1994; he was the first member of the 1952 Olympic team to die.
